sourceReview.scope: Five fixed typed Evidence stores, authenticated first-Run marker routing, compatibility and source-Run recovery; minimal parsed-index cold pre-eviction independently reviewed.

invariants: Main Run/ledger/manifestV2 consumers retain their original genuine ports and resolver brands.

Only freshly authenticated first Run event data determines existing layout. Absent marker is legacy; malformed/present unsupported marker rejects. New local UI Runs explicitly select typed-evidence-v1.
Layout metadata participates in RUN_STARTED payload digest and signed durable event bytes. Fresh ingress/start/complete checks reject concurrent layout selection mismatch before Evidence writes.
Every type maps to a genuine branded scoped port; exact data-only nonproxy map is privately frozen, root/files identities distinct, fixed expectedType routes only.
Five typed stores are narrowed individually with allowedTypes:[type]; authority options are three explicit fields and cannot override store/type selection.

All five existing roots/files/indexes must exist before construction. Physical types, single-link index and bigint identities are checked before/after construction, followed by branded directory recheck and bounded index read window.
No legacy fallback or cross-store search on typed missing/corrupt bytes. Reopened source Runs choose their own authenticated layout, independently of destination.
Index limits remain10000rows/64MiB per physicalstore; full fresh index/path/identity/payload/signature/current-authority/expiry checks remain.
Cold/rewrite parse drops prior cache and local previous reference only after fresh read/hash/active-window validation. Equal and exact-prefix paths retain original checks; no auth/payload cache.
